title: Ledger Epistemology and Regime-Closure Governance: An Operational Framework for Validation in Coupled Multi-Scale Systems
abstract: Presents a five-component operational framework to prevent narrative reabsorption in validation of coupled multi-scale systems: explicit regime tagging, frozen-parameter governance, sealed pre-registered predictions with cryptographic hashes, a public falsification ledger, and external arbitration. The framework is field-tested within the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) programme (163 DOIs, 135 registered tests, 11 falsifications; validation ledger v4.6) and shown to be portable across domains (medicine, economics, metrology).
